newsitem.title: INDIA: India RBI says monitoring rupee real exchange rate.
newsitem.headline: India RBI says monitoring rupee real exchange rate.

text.p: The Reserve Bank of India (RBI) said on Tuesday it was allowing the market to determine the rupee's exchange rate.
In an interview with Reuters Television, RBI chief Chakravarty Rangarajan said the central bank continued to monitor the real effective rate of the rupee.
"There are a number of considerations. We are now allowing the market to determine the rupee," he said.

"There is enough supply of funds in the market to keep the rupee where it is. We are concerned as always with the real effective exchange rate of the rupee as it has a bearing on the competitiveness of India's exports," Rangarajan said.
According to market sources the RBI bought more than one billion dollars in March to stop the rupee appreciating.
